query:
-- Normal week (April 13) vs Easter week (April 20) for Canton main check-in
SELECT weekStartDate, SUM(headcount) as total
FROM attendance_weekly
WHERE campus IN ('Canton','Jasper') AND weekStartDate IN ('2025-04-13','2025-04-20','2025-04-27')
GROUP BY weekStartDate ORDER BY weekStartDate;
